description: This file defines a PHP class 'File' within the namespace 'Opencart or System or Library or Cache', which manages file-based caching operations such as get, set, delete, and cleanup of cache files.
published: Opencart or System or Library or Cache or File

classes.name: File
classes.description: A class providing file-based caching functionality for the OpenCart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes cache expiration time with optional custom value (default 3600 seconds).

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves cached data by key if available, otherwise returns an empty array.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores data in cache with a specified key and expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes cache files associated with the specified key.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Cleans up expired cache files upon object destruction, with some probabilistic cleanup for stale files.
